entities.summary: Timo Tolkki (b. 1966-03-03, Nurmijärvi) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Nurmijärvi and Finland. Known in the fields of finland, composers & musicians, europe.
